refused: user: sudo on this host is sudo-rs, whose sudo -l does not list the Defaults that apply to a user, and the original sudo, which admit reads them from in its place, is not installed as /usr/bin/sudo.ws, so admit cannot tell whether one passes paisans-f2a9's environment to the WireGuard helper, which runs as root. Install Ubuntu's sudo package, which installs it, and admit again. Nothing was changed
